key_insight: The paper introduces integer hybrid path-sums (IHPS) to enable semi-automated verification and resource analysis of hybrid quantum programs with unbounded loops.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical static-analysis route for estimating termination and expected cost in real quantum software with complex classical control flow.
method: Extend path-sums to model unbounded while loops as possible executions.
Use loop invariants to reason about termination and expected resource consumption.
Implement the approach in a semi-automatic Haskell tool.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the approach on several examples and describes the implementation of a semi-automatic Haskell program, but does not provide quantitative benchmark results.
watch_item: The method is semi-automatic and depends on suitable loop invariants, which may limit scalability or require expert intervention.
paper_title: An Effective Quantum Hoare Logic for Hybrid Quantum Programs with Unbounded Loops
